title: SET_CONFIG structure
section: SET_CONFIG / main bundle and PLUGIN_CONFIG BUNDLE
text: SET_CONFIG can configure multiple options with one intent. Its main bundle can contain an array of PLUGIN_CONFIG bundles. Each plugin bundle has its own PARAM_LIST. The PLUGIN_NAME is case sensitive. The documented plugin names include BARCODE input and INTENT output.

title: SET_CONFIG version boundary
text: The SET_CONFIG API was introduced in DataWedge 6.4. Multi-plugin configuration in one intent action begins with DataWedge 6.6. DataWedge 6.5 and older require a separate intent action for each plugin.

title: Full profile single intent
section: Set configuration for multiple modules (full profile) in a single intent
text: Support for configuring a full profile with multiple modules, including plugins, APP_LIST and Data Capture Plus, in a single intent started with DataWedge 7.1. Earlier versions required multiple intent calls for multiple modules.

title: Programmer's Guide
text: The programmer's guide directs developers to SET_CONFIG to create or update profiles and configure multiple input, processing, output or utility plugins with a single intent.

title: Configuration mode
text: CONFIG_MODE supports CREATE_IF_NOT_EXIST, OVERWRITE and UPDATE. UPDATE requires the profile to exist. OVERWRITE resets all options to defaults before applying supplied settings. CREATE_IF_NOT_EXIST updates only specified parameters when the profile exists.

title: SET_CONFIG result codes
text: SET_CONFIG can return PARAMETER_INVALID for empty, null or invalid parameters and PROFILE_NOT_FOUND when an operation targets a profile that does not exist. The app must include SEND_RESULT and COMMAND_IDENTIFIER intent extras to receive result codes.

title: Check DataWedge version
section: DataWedge API Basics / Check version information
text: Use the Get Version Info API to retrieve the installed DataWedge version and determine whether a feature is supported on the device.

title: Scanner and device limits
text: Barcode scanner decode parameter support varies by scanning device. Zebra directs developers to the device-specific Integrator Guide for support details. The SET_CONFIG page alone cannot establish behavior on an unspecified device.
